section.heading: List of tobacco duty rates to be indexed under section 19AB

tr.td: Tobacco duty rates

content.p: an item in the table in Schedule 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 or 12 that relates to a subheading mentioned in paragraph (a);
the applicable rate on a day is the amount worked out using the formula:
for a day on or after the first replacement day and before the second replacement day—0.000775; or
for a day on or after the second replacement day and before the third replacement day—0.00075; or
for a day on or after the third replacement day and before the fourth replacement day—0.000725; or
for a day on or after the fourth replacement day—0.0007.
The amount worked out under subsection (1) is to be rounded to 2 decimal places (rounding up if the third decimal place is 5 or more).
(4) For the purposes of this section, the first replacement day is:
if, in relation to the indexation day that is 1 September 2017, subsection 19AB(7) has the effect of replacing a rate of duty on a later day—that later day.
(5) For the purposes of this section, the second replacement day is:
if, in relation to the indexation day that is 1 September 2018, subsection 19AB(7) has the effect of replacing a rate of duty on a later day—that later day.
(6) For the purposes of this section, the third replacement day is:
if, in relation to the indexation day that is 1 September 2019, subsection 19AB(7) has the effect of replacing a rate of duty on a later day—that later day.
(7) For the purposes of this section, the fourth replacement day is:
if, in relation to the indexation day that is 1 September 2020, subsection 19AB(7) has the effect of replacing a rate of duty on a later day—that later day.
If the applicable rate changes on a particular day, the changed rate applies in relation to:
goods imported into Australia on or after that day; and
goods imported into Australia before that day, where the time for working out the rate of import duty on the goods had not occurred before that day.
The Comptroller-General of Customs must, on or as soon as practicable after the day a rate of duty is replaced under section 19AB, publish a notice in the Gazette advertising:
the rate of duty on that day under a subheading referred to in paragraph (1)(a) or an item referred to in paragraph (1)(b); and
the goods to which that subheading or item applies.

goods imported into Australia on or after the first replacement day; and
goods imported into Australia before the first replacement day, where the time for working out the rate of import duty on the goods had not occurred before that day.
